scenarios.title: Accessing laptop registration workflow without event authorization
given: A worker accesses the registration application on a laptop without valid event authorization
scenarios.when: The worker navigates to the badge registration interface
then: The registration interface is inaccessible
A message indicating that event authorization is required is displayed

scenarios.title: Looking up an unclaimed badge by human-readable identity ID
given: An event-authorized worker is on the laptop badge registration interface
A preprinted reserved badge (e.g. "BADGE101") exists and is currently unclaimed
scenarios.when: The worker enters the human-readable identity ID of the badge and requests lookup
then: The badge is displayed as unclaimed and eligible for registration
The attendee detail entry form is presented to the worker

scenarios.title: Looking up an unclaimed badge by scanning QR code with webcam
given: An event-authorized worker is on the laptop badge registration interface
A preprinted reserved badge with a valid QR code (e.g. "BADGE102") exists and is currently unclaimed
scenarios.when: The worker scans the badge QR code using the laptop webcam
then: The badge identity is recognized
The badge is displayed as unclaimed and ready for attendee registration
The attendee detail entry form is presented to the worker

scenarios.title: Looking up an unrecognized badge identifier
given: An event-authorized worker is on the laptop badge registration interface
scenarios.when: The worker enters an unrecognized identity ID (e.g. "INVALID999") or scans an invalid QR code
then: An error message indicating the badge could not be found is displayed
The attendee detail entry form is not presented

scenarios.title: Looking up a badge that has already been claimed
given: An event-authorized worker is on the laptop badge registration interface
A preprinted badge (e.g. "BADGE103") has already been claimed for an attendee (e.g. "Jane Doe")
scenarios.when: The worker enters the identity ID or scans the QR code for the badge
then: The badge is visibly identified as already claimed
The option to claim or edit attendee details for the badge is blocked
Existing registration details for the badge are not modified

scenarios.title: Successfully claiming an unclaimed badge with attendee details
given: An event-authorized worker has retrieved an unclaimed preprinted badge (e.g. "BADGE104") on the laptop interface
scenarios.when: The worker inputs attendee details (e.g. full name "Alex Morgan" and email "alex@example.com") and submits the registration
then: A confirmation indicating successful badge registration is displayed
The badge status is updated to claimed
Subsequent lookups for the badge display the badge as claimed by the attendee

scenarios.title: Preventing duplicate registration when two workers submit concurrently for the same badge
given: Two event-authorized workers on separate laptops look up the same unclaimed badge (e.g. "BADGE105") at the same time
Both workers view the active attendee detail entry form for the badge
scenarios.when: Both workers submit their attendee registration details at the same time
then: Exactly one worker receives a confirmation that the badge was successfully registered
The other worker is visibly notified that the badge has already been claimed and the registration attempt is rejected
The attendee details from the winning registration remain intact without being overwritten

scenarios.title: Submitting registration after badge was claimed by another worker during data entry
given: An event-authorized worker loads the registration form for an unclaimed badge (e.g. "BADGE106")
Another worker completes claiming the same badge while the first worker is still on the form
scenarios.when: The first worker submits the attendee details for the badge
then: The submission is visibly rejected with a message stating the badge is already claimed
The previously saved attendee registration details on the badge are preserved without overwrite

scenarios.title: Submitting registration without entering required attendee details
given: An event-authorized worker is viewing the registration form for an unclaimed badge (e.g. "BADGE107")
scenarios.when: The worker attempts to submit the claim with mandatory attendee fields left blank
then: Validation messages highlighting the missing required fields are displayed
The registration is not submitted
The badge remains in an unclaimed state
